_comment: AGOL identifiers for the CDOT TDM Calculator TAZ data. Single source of truth for the publish pipeline AND the app's .env. publish_enriched_taz.py READS this to resolve the target org/portal and (with --overwrite) the existing hosted feature layer item to refresh in place, and WRITES new item IDs + the feature layer service URL back here after a CREATE publish (so the next run can --overwrite). Empty string = not published yet. Derive the app's .env from these: VITE_PORTAL_URL <- portal_url, VITE_TAZ_LAYER_URL <- feature_layer_url, VITE_WEBMAP_ITEM_ID <- web_map_item_id. Select an environment with --env {staging,prod}.
